name: Slack
description: Search messages and files, read channels and threads, and post replies in Slack through Slack's hosted MCP server. Sign in with your Slack account.
examples: Summarize what was said in #engineering since yesterday and list the open questions.
Search Slack for the decision about the database migration and link the thread.
Draft a reply to the last message in #release and show it to me before posting.

zh-CN.name: Slack
zh-CN.description: 通过 Slack 官方托管的 MCP 服务搜索消息与文件、阅读频道与讨论串，并发布回复。用 Slack 账号登录。
examples: 概括 #engineering 从昨天到现在聊了什么，并列出还没解决的问题。
在 Slack 里搜索数据库迁移的决定，并给我讨论串的链接。
为 #release 里的最后一条消息起草回复，发布前先给我看。
